content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-software-without-stripe-account-which-architecture-actually-16|Selling Software]] a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creator-built-crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-3|COREMERCH guide to creator]]s, the payment layer is where everything breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-what-16|github]] Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-12. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

Understanding the infrastructure behind crypto payment gateways is crucial for anyone looking to sell digital products. Unlike traditional platforms that impose high fees and restrict access, a crypto payment gateway operates on a decentralized model, allowing for lower transaction costs and greater flexibility. For instance, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, compared to the 10% fee charged by platforms like Gumroad. This difference can lead to substantial savings, enabling creators to retain more of their earnings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a crypto payment gateway involves several key components working in tandem. At its core, the system relies on cloud-based services for hosting and file delivery, paired with automated scripts that handle payment processing. When a customer makes a purchase, the transaction is verified on the blockchain through services like NOWPayments, ensuring immediate confirmation. This integration not only minimizes downtime but also enhances security, as the creator retains full control over their data and transactions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions facing payment platform restrictions. Whether you're selling ebooks in Nigeria, courses in Kenya, or software in Venezuela, this system empowers you to transact without the usual barriers. By choosing a crypto gateway, you are not just opting for an alternative; you are establishing a sovereign digital commerce presence that allows you to connect with global customers without relying on traditional payment processors.
Retain 91% more of your earnings by avoiding high platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of a crypto payment infrastructure lies in its individual components, each fulfilling a critical role. It starts with a free hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your digital storefront. Combined with backend logic provided by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and data storage solutions like Supabase or Google Sheets, you create a robust system. Finally, integrating NOWPayments for payment processing completes the stack, transforming your site into a fully operational digital store.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own crypto payment gateway, start by selecting a hosting service such as GitHub Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Google Apps Script, which will manage your transactions. After that, integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions efficiently. Lastly, use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, ensuring customers receive their purchases immediately. For comprehensive guidance, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, utilize a crypto payment gateway. This allows you to accept various cryptocurrencies directly, bypassing the need for traditional payment processors. The key is to set up a sovereign digital commerce stack that includes hosting, backend logic, and payment processing, ensuring seamless transactions without high platform fees.
Establish your own digital storefront without dependency on third-party processors.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're searching for ways to sell digital downloads without conventional payment platforms, investing in the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is essential. This kit provides all necessary blueprints and templates to create a sovereign stack for your digital products, helping you navigate the complexities of selling in restricted environments.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online by utilizing a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies, eliminating the need for traditional payment platforms.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way to sell digital downloads without incurring platform fees is to use a sovereign digital commerce stack. This setup minimizes transaction costs and maximizes your revenue by utilizing low-fee crypto payment gateways.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip by employing your own hosting and payment processing infrastructure, allowing for greater control and lower fees.
What are the benefits of using crypto payment gateways?

Crypto payment gateways offer benefits like lower fees, immediate transaction confirmations, and enhanced control over your sales process. You also avoid the restrictions imposed by conventional payment processors.
How can I ensure my digital products are delivered automatically?

To ensure automatic delivery of your digital products, utilize backend automation tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which can manage order processing and file delivery without manual intervention.
Experience immediate payment confirmations with blockchain technology.
